speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a skin condition on your left dorsal hand; can you describe when you first noticed it and if it has spread?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old female. The patient is here for an annual well-check. She has a history of well-controlled diabetes and hypertension, managed with metformin and losartan, respectively. She reports maintaining a healthy diet primarily consisting of vegetables and lean meat, denies any tobacco or alcohol use, and enjoys outdoor activities like walking and sunbathing.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Actinic Keratosis (AK). The patient's history of sunbathing, age, and the location on the dorsal hand are classic risk factors. I am requesting an image of the lesion to confirm the presence of rough, sandpaper-like scaly patches before proceeding with treatment options.
